# Web icons — GENERATED, DO NOT EDIT

> **Do not edit these files by hand.** They are generated from
> [`../../assets/icon/icon.svg`](../../assets/icon/icon.svg) by
> [`../../scripts/generate-icons.mjs`](../../scripts/generate-icons.mjs):
>
> ```bash
> npm run icons                                        # the full set, 40 files
> node scripts/generate-icons.mjs --preview             # candidate designs, 512 + 96 px
> ```
>
> The same run also writes the Android launcher icons, the iOS `AppIcon` set and
> `public/og.png`. See `docs/STORE_LISTING.md` for the platform rules the generator
> enforces (iOS icons square with no alpha; Android adaptive foreground transparent and
> inside the 66 % safe zone).

| File | Size | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `icon-192.png` | 192×192 | PWA manifest (`any`) |
| `icon-512.png` | 512×512 | PWA manifest (`any`) |
| `icon-maskable-512.png` | 512×512 | PWA manifest (`maskable`) — glyph scaled to the inner 80 %, background full-bleed |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | 180×180 | iOS home-screen bookmark — **square**, because iOS applies its own mask |
| `favicon-32.png` | 32×32 | Browser tab |

## The Play Store listing icon

`release/play-store-icon-512.png` — 512 × 512, square, opaque. Generated by the same
command, and **gitignored** with the rest of `release/`, so it is a build artifact rather
than a tracked file. Upload it under *Store presence → Main store listing → App icon*.

## History

These files were placeholders until 2026-10-24: five resized copies of Capacitor's default
template icon, because the project had no artwork. Tracked as `G25` and now closed — the
mark is a seat glyph on the brand blue `#2563eb`.
